description: Governed JSON-managed controlled values for the ProcessMapping process intelligence repository

value_groups.description: Transcript-derived activity classes used during process extraction and analysis

values.Label: Data Entry
values.Description: Entering or updating data in a system

values.Label: Review / Approval
values.Description: Reviewing information and granting or denying approval

values.Label: System Lookup
values.Description: Looking up information in a system for reference or verification

values.Label: Document Generation
values.Description: Creating or generating a document, report, or correspondence

values.Label: Communication
values.Description: Sending or receiving communication (email, notification, phone call)

values.Label: Decision Point
values.Description: Evaluating conditions and choosing a path forward

values.Label: Calculation / Validation
values.Description: Performing calculations or validating data accuracy

values.Label: Filing / Archival
values.Description: Filing documents or archiving records for retention

value_groups.description: Recurring research-administration roles referenced in process maps

values.Label: Grants Specialist
values.Description: OSP staff member who processes awards and proposals

values.Label: Grants Officer
values.Description: Senior OSP staff with signing authority

values.Label: Principal Investigator
values.Description: Lead researcher on a project

values.Label: Department Administrator
values.Description: Department-level administrative support

values.Label: Fiscal Officer
values.Description: Financial management staff

values.Label: Compliance Officer
values.Description: Staff responsible for regulatory compliance

values.Label: Sponsor
values.Description: External funding agency

values.Label: Post-Award Specialist
values.Description: OSP staff member who processes post-award modifications including amendments, rebudgets, PI changes, and no-cost extensions

values.Label: Financial Unit Specialist
values.Description: Financial unit staff member who sets up new awards in Banner, verifies billing configuration, and manages financial reporting events

values.Label: Pre-Award Sponsored Programs Administrator
values.Description: OSP staff member who reviews proposals, checks document completeness, and manages pre-award submission processes

values.Label: Departmental Grant Administrator
values.Description: Department-level administrator who manages grant activities and serves as liaison between PI and OSP

values.Label: Pre-Award Manager
values.Description: OSP supervisor who oversees pre-award SPA team, manages workload distribution, provides weekly metrics, and leads bi-weekly workload meetings

values.Label: Authorized Organizational Representative
values.Description: University official with authority to submit proposals and sign awards on behalf of the institution

values.Label: Senior Grants & Contracts Analyst
values.Description: Senior OSP analyst who handles complex grant and contract administration

values.Label: Sponsored Programs Officer
values.Description: OSP officer who oversees sponsored program administration and compliance

values.Label: Assistant Director for Sponsored Accounting
values.Description: Senior financial staff who oversees sponsored accounting functions including final billing and financial reporting

value_groups.description: High-level categories for actors inside a process map

values.Label: Person
values.Description: A specific individual

values.Label: Role
values.Description: A role that could be filled by different people (e.g., Grants Specialist)

values.Label: System
values.Description: A software system or automated process

values.Label: External
values.Description: An external entity (sponsor, subrecipient, vendor)

value_groups.description: Source transcript file formats accepted into governed transcript workflows

values.Label: WebVTT
values.Description: Web Video Text Tracks format — caption/subtitle file from video recording

values.Label: Plain Text
values.Description: Plain text transcript file

values.Label: Word Document
values.Description: Microsoft Word document with transcript notes

values.Label: Markdown
values.Description: Markdown-formatted transcript file

value_groups.description: Institutional process families represented by canonical process maps

values.Label: Pre-Award
values.Description: Processes related to proposal preparation, submission, and pre-award activities

values.Label: Post-Award
values.Description: Processes related to award setup, management, and closeout

values.Label: Compliance
values.Description: Processes related to regulatory compliance (IRB, IACUC, COI, etc.)

values.Label: Financial
values.Description: Processes related to financial management, budgeting, and reporting

values.Label: Subaward
values.Description: Processes related to subaward issuance, monitoring, and closeout

values.Label: Reporting
values.Description: Processes related to progress reports, financial reports, and deliverables

values.Label: Contracting
values.Description: Processes related to agreements, contracts, and negotiations

value_groups.description: Transcript processing stages from raw ingestion through structured mapping

values.Label: Raw
values.Description: Transcript is in its original unprocessed form

values.Label: Parsed
values.Description: Transcript has been parsed into structured segments but not yet mapped to a process

values.Label: Mapped
values.Description: Transcript has been fully mapped to one or more structured process definitions

value_groups.description: PII redaction review states tracked for transcript assets

values.Label: Not Redacted
values.Description: Transcript has not been reviewed for PII redaction

values.Label: Partially Redacted
values.Description: Some PII has been redacted but review may be incomplete

values.Label: Fully Redacted
values.Description: All PII has been reviewed and redacted

value_groups.description: Process-step types used inside canonical process maps

values.Label: Action
values.Description: A step where an actor performs a specific action

values.Label: Decision
values.Description: A branching point where the process flow depends on a condition

values.Label: Review
values.Description: A step where information is reviewed or evaluated

values.Label: Approval
values.Description: A step where formal approval is granted or denied

values.Label: Data Entry
values.Description: A step where data is entered into a system

values.Label: Communication
values.Description: A step involving communication (email, phone, meeting)

values.Label: Wait
values.Description: A step where the process pauses for external input or a time period

values.Label: Subprocess
values.Description: A step that references another process map
